Title: General Availability: Major version upgrade logs for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server

Body.Content:
We're excited to announce the addition of the PostgreSQL version upgrade logs (PG_Upgrade_Logs) feature to Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server. This enhancement is designed to streamline your experience during major version upgrades, providing easy access to PostgreSQL major version upgrade logs directly through the familiar Server Logs UI. With PG_Upgrade_Logs, you'll gain invaluable insights into the upgrade process, significantly improving your ability to troubleshoot effectively. These logs can be easily configured and accessed through the Azure Portal or via CLI, and integrated into your existing workflow.

Learn more.
